description: Create a water quality monitoring spreadsheet for Mill Creek with 12 sampling events. Organize scattered data into a structured dataset with proper headers (Date, Time, Location Code, pH, Dissolved Oxygen, Nitrates, Water Temp, Weather, Notes). Add summary calculations (average pH excluding kit malfunction, average DO, average Nitrates, max Nitrates, count of low DO samples). Apply conditional formatting to highlight concerning values. Add data validation to pH column.
